title: Live-forward capture recorded nothing on no-pick skip days (idled at pending_pick) until the D8 research capture (5/09–9/14)
tier_reason: research coverage only: the frozen candidate's pre-outcome slate was never exported on no-pick days, so no captured data was lost and the official stream (P-04 production-pick parity) excludes those days by construction; no delivery/entry/state/alerting impact and no residual reaches production

contract.text: Before 2026-09-14 the capture's documented contract was to wait for the production pick file and export candidate-vs-production slates only when one exists (no-pick days are outside the official stream, matching P-04 production-pick parity); from 2026-09-14 (owner decision D8) a no-pick day with a current skip intent gets a separately labelled research capture before first pitch.
contract.source: scripts/live_forward_capture_once.py module docstring at db7289f; docs/audit/2026-09-22-exposure-register.md §B P-04 and §C D8; commit 155f1e7 body

mechanism.text: capture_once returned status pending_pick (exit 0, no capture_status.json written) whenever the date's production pick file did not exist; the 15-minute timer (05:00–22:45 ET) repeated this all day, so on every no-pick skip day the candidate's pre-outcome slate was never exported and the official root holds no record of the day

verified_recovered.how: operator record that the D8 research captures were verified 9/19–9/21 (artifacts on the box, not read here)

residual.text: The skip days 5/09–9/14 have no pre-outcome slate and cannot be recaptured (pre-outcome requirement); D8 research captures are ineligible for P-04 by construction

Without a research capture the pending_pick branch still writes no status file, so an absent official-root date directory cannot by itself distinguish an ineligible no-pick day from a capture that never ran; completeness checks must join decision.json

watchdog.trigger: by first pitch − 5 min of the day's earliest game: a day with a production pick lacks an official capture directory with a passing verification, or (research flag enabled) a no-pick day with a current skip intent lacks research_capture.accepted.json published before first pitch
watchdog.recovery_assertion: every eligible day ends with an accepted official or research capture published pregame, or an explicit ineligibility record joined from decision.json

evidence.locator: commit 155f1e7 message body (count taken over the official root on the box — not read)
evidence.what: the live-forward capture idled at pending_pick on every skip day: 11 of 79 decision days since 5/09 have no ranked slate for exactly this reason
